content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES DGM (Civil – Marine Structural Expert) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the fees is 19 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the DGM post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time bachelor's degree in civil engineering and a post-graduation in Marine Structures, Coastal Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the DGM (Civil – Marine Structural Expert) post is 41 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the DGM post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the DGM (Civil – Marine Structural Expert) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the DGM post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay Rs. 600/- plus applicable taxes as the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates will receive a refund of their application fee upon participation in the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the DGM post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the RITES office located?
faq.answer: The RITES office is located in Gurgaon, Haryana, with a pincode of 122001.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the RITES official website or the direct application link provided before the last date of 19 October 2026.
